# Hyperspace

> > Hyperspace is a metaverse platform for business that enables organizations to create immersive virtual environments for collaboration, engagement, and innovation.

Hyperspace, developed by ExitReality Inc, provides enterprise-grade metaverse solutions designed to help businesses leverage virtual environments for team collaboration and customer engagement. The platform emphasizes accessibility through personalized demos and transparent legal frameworks.
